pages.text: $(item)Pulsar Crust$(). Iron from the crust of a neutron star, magnetised by its field. Squeezed with iron-nickel under 80 tesla, it becomes magnetar crust.
$(thing)Found$(): The Pulsar Field.$(br2)$(thing)Used$(): Two with two Iron-Nickel become a Magnetar Crust Fragment in the Pulsed Magnet Lab, at 80 T.
